starfleet.description: Starfleet is the primary exploratory, scientific, and defensive arm of the United Federation of Planets. Founded in the 22nd century, Starfleet's mission is to explore strange new worlds, seek out new life and new civilizations, and to boldly go where no one has gone before.

command.description: Commanding officers, first officers, and tactical officers

science.description: Science officers, medical officers, and navigators

eras.name: The Original Series Era
eras.description: The era of the USS Enterprise (NCC-1701) under Captain James T. Kirk. This period saw the exploration of the galaxy, first contact with numerous civilizations, and conflicts with the Klingons, Romulans, and various threats.
key_events: The death of Spock and his resurrection

eras.name: The Next Generation Era
eras.description: The era of the USS Enterprise-D and E under Captain Jean-Luc Picard. This period saw the rise of the Borg threat, the Dominion War, and the exploration of the Delta Quadrant.

eras.name: The Kelvin Timeline
eras.description: An alternate timeline created by the time-traveling Nero. This era saw a younger Kirk rise to command of the USS Enterprise and face threats including Khan Noonien Singh and the Klingons.
key_events: The Battle of the Klingon frontier

federation.name: United Federation of Planets
federation.description: A democratic interstellar federation of planets dedicated to peace, exploration, and scientific discovery. Earth is a founding member.
federation.motto: Peace through strength, strength through unity

klingon_empire.name: Klingon Empire
klingon_empire.description: A warrior culture that values honor, strength, and combat. The Klingons are both allies and adversaries of the Federation.
klingon_empire.motto: The life of the Empire is the strength of the warrior

romulan_star_empire.name: Romulan Star Empire
romulan_star_empire.description: A secretive and militaristic empire that borders the Federation. The Romulans are masters of deception and strategy.
romulan_star_empire.motto: The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few

borg_collective.name: Borg Collective
borg_collective.description: A cybernetic hive mind that assimilates other species to achieve perfection. The Borg are the greatest threat to individuality in the galaxy.
borg_collective.motto: You will be assimilated. Resistance is futile.

dominion.name: The Dominion
dominion.description: A powerful empire ruled by the Founders, shape-shifting beings who control the Jem'Hadar and Vorta. The Dominion seeks to control all of space.

augment.name: Augments
augment.description: Genetically enhanced humans who rose to power during the Eugenics Wars. Khan Noonien Singh was the most famous Augment.

james_t_kirk.name: James T. Kirk
james_t_kirk.description: Legendary Starfleet captain who commanded the USS Enterprise. Known for his bold, intuitive leadership style and his willingness to bend regulations to do what's right.
notable_quotes: There's always another way, Spock. There always is.
I'm playing the man, not the odds.

spock.name: Spock
spock.description: Half-Human, Half-Vulcan Science Officer who serves as the logical counterbalance to Captain Kirk's intuition. A bridge between two cultures and two ways of thinking.
notable_quotes: The needs of the many outweigh the needs of the few, or the one.

leonard_mccoy.name: Leonard 'Bones' McCoy
leonard_mccoy.description: Chief Medical Officer of the USS Enterprise, known for his compassion, his skepticism of technology, and his role as the moral conscience of the crew.
notable_quotes: Of all the souls I have encountered in my travels, humanity has always been the most bizarre.

data.name: Lieutenant Commander Data
data.description: Soong-type android who serves as the Executive Officer of the USS Enterprise-D. His quest to understand humanity challenges the definition of sentience and personhood.

jean_luc_picard.name: Jean-Luc Picard
jean_luc_picard.description: Legendary Starfleet captain who commanded the USS Enterprise-D and E. Known for his diplomatic approach, his love of literature, and his fight against the Borg.

khan_noonien_singh.name: Khan Noonien Singh
khan_noonien_singh.description: Genetically augmented superhuman who ruled a third of Earth during the Eugenics Wars. Exiled into space, he became one of the most dangerous adversaries in the galaxy.
notable_quotes: His whole life he has searched for a worthy adversary. Has he found one? Has I?
You would have to sentence all of mankind to death to punish me for what I have done.

human.name: Human
human.description: A diverse and adaptable species from Planet Earth. Humans are known for their curiosity, ambition, and capacity for both great good and great evil.

vulcan.name: Vulcan
vulcan.description: A logical and disciplined species from the planet Vulcan. Vulcans suppress their emotions in favor of logic and reason.

android.name: Android (Soong-type)
android.description: Artificial beings created by Dr. Noonien Soong to be indistinguishable from humans. Androids possess superhuman abilities and an insatiable curiosity about humanity.

augment.name: Augment
augment.description: Genetically enhanced humans who possess superior strength, intelligence, and charisma. Augments were banned after the Eugenics Wars.

uss_enterprise_ncc_1701.name: USS Enterprise (NCC-1701)
uss_enterprise_ncc_1701.description: The iconic starship commanded by Captain Kirk during the Original Series. The Enterprise explored the galaxy and faced numerous threats.

uss_enterprise_ncc_1701_d.name: USS Enterprise-D (NCC-1701-D)
uss_enterprise_ncc_1701_d.description: The flagship of the Federation during the TNG era. The Enterprise-D was a city-sized starship with a crew of over 1,000.

uss_enterprise_ncc_1701_e.name: USS Enterprise-E (NCC-1701-E)
uss_enterprise_ncc_1701_e.description: The successor to the Enterprise-D, the Enterprise-E was a more advanced and powerful starship designed for exploration and combat.

prime_directive.name: Prime Directive
prime_directive.description: The First Directive of Starfleet, prohibiting interference with the natural development of less advanced civilizations. Violating the Prime Directive is a serious offense.

transporter.name: Transporter
transporter.description: A device that dematerializes matter at one location and rematerializes it at another. The transporter is used for beaming personnel and objects between ships and planets.

tricorder.name: Tricorder
tricorder.description: A handheld scanning device used by Starfleet officers to analyze biological, chemical, and physical phenomena. Medical tricorders are used for diagnostic purposes.

phasers.name: Phasers
phasers.description: The standard energy weapon of Starfleet. Phasers can be set to stun or kill, and are used for defense and combat.

warp_drive.name: Warp Drive
warp_drive.description: A propulsion system that allows starships to travel faster than light by creating a warp bubble around the ship. Warp factors range from 1 to 9+.
